messages.subject: dataProcess error
parts:
Hello, 
I am trying to use the MSstats package in r and keep running into this error.
 Subject : 1, Condition : 1 has multiple rows (duplicate rows) for some features 
the raw data we have is not an output from Skyline or MaxQ therefore I had to manually input Condition = 1,2 ;  BioRepicate = 1 ; Run = 1,2 
I took the data called it condition c1, then copied the data and made the intensity*2 and labeled that as c2 with the corresponding Run 1 and 2 just so i could have 2 conditions and 2runs to see if it would work but I run into an error

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: dataProcess error
parts:
Hi,


converter functions summarize the data so that there is a single observation per run per feature. Please run your data through the MSstatsConvert::MSstatsPreprocess function. It performs all steps required for dataProcess input. Let me know if you
run into any problems.


Kind regards
Mateusz
